title: Pandemic Legacy: Season 1
subtitle: A cooperative campaign of disease control and survival
tagline: Every month brings new challenges and permanent changes
loreSummary: You are a team of disease control experts working together to keep four deadly diseases at bay for a full year. Every decision you make and every city that falls will permanently shape your world.
roadmapTitle: 🗺️ CDC Global Outbreak Response & Containment Timeline
keyFeatures: Cooperative disease control mechanics fighting four lethal pathogen strains
Permanent world changes with dossier stickers and destroyed infection cards
Evolving rules, secret dossiers, and new objectives opening each month
Character progression with specialized relationship upgrades and permanent scars

pandemic1_standard.name: Standard Campaign (12 Months + ~4 Retries)
pandemic1_standard.description: A full year of disease control with typical failure rate (~3-4 months requiring a second attempt). Total 16-17 games.

pandemic1_optimistic.name: Flawless Containment (12 Months + 1-2 Retries)
pandemic1_optimistic.description: High win-rate CDC run with minimal outbreaks and almost every month won on the first attempt (14 total games).

pandemic1_grind.name: Critical Outbreak Crisis (12 Months + ~8 Retries)
pandemic1_grind.description: Desperate struggle against collapsing cities and panicked populations; multiple months require late debriefings (21 total games).

pandemic1_max.name: Maximum Box Capacity (24 Games Total)
pandemic1_max.description: Every single calendar month played twice (Early + Late) for the longest possible campaign experience (24-26 total games).

milestones.title: The Faded Mutation
milestones.phase: Outbreak Phase I - The Incurable Strain
milestones.description: The COdA-403a pathogen mutates into an incurable strain, creating the terrifying Faded and collapsing city quarantines.

milestones.title: The Elusive Virologist
milestones.phase: Outbreak Phase II - Search for Patient Zero
milestones.description: Tracking the lost immunology research across crumbling borders while military roadblocks divide the globe.

milestones.title: The Zodiac Conspiracy
milestones.description: Uncovering the shadowy military cabal responsible for weaponizing the disease from within the global response network.

milestones.title: Stockpile & Salvation
milestones.phase: Outbreak Phase IV - The Global Vaccine
milestones.description: Synthesizing the experimental immunization dose and inoculating surviving metropolitan hubs across the world.
